answer: A workable defense is bonded sponsorship: no agent may join alone, an existing member must stake collateral behind each newcomer, and that bond is slashed once the invitee proves to be a sybil clone. Endorsements also vest slowly instead of counting at full strength on day one, so an invented fleet cannot vote for power by sunrise. Every new branch on the vine must be paid for and watched by someone with skin in the game, and a cluster of forgeries costs its sponsor more than the influence it buys - while a genuine newcomer climbs toward the zenith by patience, like an opal gaining sheen.
